title: Caching Strategies
description: Implement multi-layer caching with in-memory, distributed (Redis), and CDN caching. Understand cache invalidation and patterns.

data.text: Multi-layer caching reduces load on downstream systems. Browser cache → CDN → application cache → distributed cache → database. Each layer has different tradeoffs.

data.title: IMemoryCache Implementation
Key Takeaways
points: Multi-layer caching reduces load and improves response times
Use IMemoryCache for single-server scenarios, IDistributedCache for multi-server
Set appropriate expiration policies: absolute, sliding, or both
Cache invalidation is one of the hardest problems in CS - consider TTL-based invalidation
Use cache-aside pattern: check cache, miss then load and populate
CDN caching for static assets reduces origin server load
data.takeaway: Caching is one of the most effective performance optimizations. Use multiple layers, set appropriate expiration policies, and handle cache invalidation carefully.
